text: Creamy and aromatic latte, fresh and delicious orange juice!
The espresso coffee was refreshing after a long day of exploring the city. This place has a wide impressive range of specialty coffees as well.

Top marks for flavour and modernity. Order a cappuccino and you will get the loveliest flavour hit in a delightful stemless porcelain cup on a wooden tray. Service will also be attentive and prompt. The cat who comes for food outside makes it all even better. Glad to have visited!

It's a very nice , very inviting little coffee shop in the center of bukarest. They have great coffee and the very inviting environment. We were one day after Christmas, so it was cold and they were a bit low on fresh pastries but coffee was great and the ambience even better. I would recommend it ez a place for a short coffee break when your walking tour in this area of the city
Really wanted a good coffee. Found this place through google, great coffee at reasonable prices, great atmosphere and friendly staff

This coffee shop was the first place we visited on our holiday and it summed up how much Bucharest has changed since I last spent any time there. There are so many coffee shops now- and this is clearly one of the best ones. Very nicely designed, good coffee and in a great location too, just outside of the old town.
Great coffee and very friendly staff in the center of Bucharest. I definitely recommend it either to grab a coffee or sit and enjoy it on site.
Very reasonably priced and very tasty coffee (choice of blends). Can’t fault it. Staff friendly and helpful. Spoke good english too.
This was a charming coffee shop that roasts their own beans and has fantastic fresh fruit drinks, too. Enjoyed sitting outside on a nice day and people watching.

A great spot to grab a cup of coffee. Coffee itself is excellent. Staff very friendly. The dining room opens up to the sidewalk. There are also tables on the sidewalk available. Cocktails are available in the evening.
Excellent coffee, nice pastries and friendly service. A nice find while exploring the lovely old town of Bucharest. [cafe] is worth plugging into Google Maps.
200/100 experience Friendly staff excellent coffee and they refilled our water with filtered water. Please go and support them Bucharest needs more places and staff like this!

We ordered two avocado, toast & egg and were the only customers at the time. I was asked where we were sat and told them. Other customers started to arrive and were quickly served their food. After 30 minutes waiting we asked where our food was only to find out they’d given it to another table who arrived after us. We got a refund and went to another place who were much more professional. We would not return or recommend here.

They have a ridiculous new rule, not written anywhere, that people are not allowed to use laptops on weekends, in order to make it more of a social space and raise consumption 😂 after I bought a coffee and opened my laptop in silence, the waiter came to require me to stop the laptop due to this ridiculous rule. It had not been mentioned anywhere before. Everyone knows this place as a working environment. But now they want to change it for more consumption 😅
We had such a great time at [cafe]! Delicious breakfast and creamy coffee! 🤩❤️ easy to find an in a quiet area.thank you🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍🤍

Stopped here for breakfast. The food was not what I ordered and they changed it with something else with no refund. Dry croissant no jam or honey to make it more acceptable. Staff was rude and putting all problems on us!!!
They are not very nice, they stand around a bit. Croissant was dry, juice was watery. All together also very expensive. Did not enjoy my experience.
Nice cosy café in the heart of Bucharest. Perfect for chill or work. The coffees and food are very good. A bit pricey but the quality is worthy.

Probably the place where you can find the best coffee around Bucharest, as they serve the Danish specialty coffee - [brand]. Nice food options and great working space. Also a great spot for night gatherings with friends with nice tapas and wines.

We had a coffee with a friend. Friendly and nice service, we managed to stop time before heading to an appointment. Definetly a spot to take a coffee and relax or have a casual talk with a friend, in couple or maybe a business rendezvous.

Good croissant and pain au chocolat. Prosciutto cotto so and so. Not the best coffee (most probably over roasted) and also not the best welcoming from the staff (I think the only nice person was the cashier). The staff was outside having their coffee when we arrived 2 minutes before the opening hours and wanted to take a look inside and see if we choose to stay inside or outside, but we were told to wait outside. We understood that. We really wanted to try this place out. But the sigh of one of their staff members when we asked if we could join another table as we were a bigger group of people really put us off and despite of that we decided to stay there. Their attitude is like "you're bothering" and the stuff from the menu is overpriced. Unfortunately, we're not coming back there.
Terrible service and staff! Never again! Another hipster coffee shop with awful services, coffee has an average taste and body which makes the price not worth it

Worst experience ever with a coffee house! Second time my simple entrance to the shop was denied on grounds of “pandemic limitation” without even asking if i would consider takeaway! Plus, coffee has an average taste and body which makes the price not worth it
Excellent place very good coffee and really warm atmosphere. Self service and friendly hospitality. Also a good place for a snack
It is a work coffee with a good selection of coffee beans (and vegetal milks) as well as classical brunch dishes for this kind of establishment (avocado toast, banana bread etc).
Hipster coffee with good music, vibe and of course food and drinks. Kind of addicted on the salmon wrap a must try. Also you can work with laptop or just chat

I went there during a solo-travelling trip. I was searching for a quiet place in which I could read a book and I found [cafe]! Great place for chill and study. I ordered a matcha latte and the milk was foamed perfectly, I was really surprised. You have to order and pay at the counter, which is a comfortable choice, so you can just leave the place whenever you like.
Amazing brekkie! Good choice. Hipster cafe. Only negative is they wouldn’t give us mimosas even though they had Prosecco and orange juice!

What makes this place amazing is the friendliness of the staff and customers. It’s unlike other coffeeshops around the neighborhood because of the good energy projected by everyone around. I love how much natural light there is in there, the plants, the cool design pieces, fun chit chat you can have with people around you or the cool people you can see there (and dogs!!!). I always feel productive when I’m taking my laptop to have some work done because of all these factors. And, of course, the coffee, the cocktails, the food are not just tasteful, but also greatly served. They also have one of the best matcha lattes in Bucharest. Overall, i think I’ve been to [cafe] unaccountable times, even daily at some points in my life such as this early 2020, and I will keep on enjoying it and with friends, but also with my dog before we head on to the park.
The place has a really good vibe, the food is excellent and the waiters are really nice! They even helped with directions to our next destination!

One of best coffee places in town. Obviously they have great coffee, but they also have great cookies/sweets and good salads/sandwiches. At walking distance from many of the interesting places to see and visit in Bucharest. It's also pet- and kids-friendly, actually that's one of the few pets-friendly places that I know of in Bucharest.

[cafe] is my favorite place in Bucharest for drinking specialty coffee (their flat white is great), having brunch (you should really try the avo-toast) or deserts. [cafe] is also very work-friendly, I often come here with my laptop and work for a couple of hours, in a welcoming scandinavian design. I also recommend it as one of the most pet-friendly places in town, known for its Dogs of [cafe] 🙂.

I had expected more from this place and I was a bit disappointed. It took them more than 30 minutes to finish a sandwich and an egg breakfast and I was only able to receive the order after I'd gone to speak to the waiter. Also very crowded and noisy. The food was tasty though.

Nice place, kind staff, good extraction in Hario V60 and espresso. I drunk a very good Etiopia in espresso double shot, floral and fruity, then a natural Honduras in V60 that was unfortunately old crop with a strong straw, paper and wood aroma! Food for a light lunch very good.

Serving the drink order after serving the food, while preparing the food (soup of the day) took approximately 20-25 mins, doesn't seem like a very good service etiquette to me. Other than this, quite mediocre, extremely noisy and unreasonably hyped (based on a few visits).
So unik place and amazing food The best breakfast place we been in bucharest The avocado toast and the salad with mozzarella whas perfect
Really bad coffee. The employes weren't friendly. They went outside to smoke while i was waiting to pay the bill. Do not recomend.
i ordered capuccino (soooo creamy!!) and hummus wrap. The best i ever had. You should visit this place!

Another hipster concept with awful services,forgetful waiters, very bad coffee and very expensive bottled beer with rusted pipe flavor. If you are the middle-class ubershallow corporate type with enough money to trow away on premium mediocre crap this is your place .... between tens of other places just the same where you can you feel special and yourself.

Good coffee, yummy light meals and salads (sometimes hard to come by in Romania) - not cheap but not obscene, neither. Great place to stop any time of the day for tourists and locals alike. Close to our hostel, [hostel]. Mostly a young, friendly staff and they all spoke English - which helped us, "unilingual" Canadians that we are.
Had brunch at this place, really delicious food and tasty coffee. Highly recommend it!
Lovely cafe with friendly staff. Food was delicious and nicely created. Highly recommend!! Tasty menus and healthy choices

So I went to this place randomly with some of my friends and all I can say apart from the fact that the prices are way too hight for what they offer, i believe that the food is a total joke. Even a 10 yo could make better stuff than this. Total piece of crap and their coffee is rotten or something, tastes like dirt. Never again

My husband and I went here at 8 a.m. to grab breakfast. We ordered a cappuccino and a tea, the yogurt with peanut butter granola and the salmon toast. They were fresh and healthy. A good spot, but very small, and not many tables. Go early to get a seat.
Very friendly service ❤️ We had a poached egg on a brioche with turkey which was amazing, also the fresh orange juice was delicious
Little place with chill music, good coffee, friendly staff. The Chocolate cookie was great. A free glass of water is also offered.
Good place for brunch. Granola is excellent. Very crunchy and yummy. And they have oat milk for those that want non-dairy options.
Food was delicious, and the lemonade had a very balanced taste. Coffee was also good. It took some time to wait for the food to be prepared though…
We found this place by recommendation and it did not disappoint, in fact we came back a second time. The food is amazing, so is the coffee and the staff are so nice.

A lovely small café with a nice menu, friendly and attentive staff, and variety of coffee selections to enjoy - ideal for tourists that are looking for a nice spot for breakfast in the early hours of the day. Their menu is available both online via scanning the QR code on your table, or traditional printed menus in both Romanian & English.
What is good to mix with cold brew coffee? Here you can taste a large various of coffee. You can have a lot of options and the location and people are very nice.
It was a highlight moment for me. The dishes were super yummy and curated excellent. I totally recommend it for a quick bite. It is super small but I like it. It's not touristic, and feels more cozy.

We heard that here at [cafe] they serve amazingly good tasty coffee, speciality coffee and so we went to have one. We served Ethiopian specialty coffee along with a slice of banana bread and home-made bar of chocolate. We had the most amazing coffee ever! And we do love coffee and we tasted Colombian coffee originally brought from Cali, Colombia ([brand]) but we liked this one from [cafe] so much more. We totally recommend the place inside is nicely designed and outside they also had a terrace with blankets but we preferred inside since it was December and kind of cold.
I wanted to grab a cup of fresh specialty coffee, and was amazed by the taste and the service. Next time I’m in Bucharest this is where I’m having my coffee 100%!
Great coffee and nice atmosphere to spend some time with your friends or spouse. Friendly staff and help you to find the best drink
Fantastic signature drinks, especially "ethiopia". Super chill atmosphere with nice waitres. Highly recommended for a chill drink or coffee

I visited three times on my short trip to Bucharest and tried espresso, long black and cappuccino - all were excellent. After a long, exhausting day of tourism I tried their espresso martini - that was good and made with a great deal of care. A small chocolate cake with maybe three nuts on top didn't work for me, a bit rubbery in texture, reminded me of some of the weaker attempts at vegan cakes (I don't know if it was vegan). Convenient location in Old Town. It's a short, pleasant walk through a park from the parliament building so it's a good spot for a coffee before or after tours. It's a fairly small place inside but when it's warm there's a lot more seating outside. I liked the Honduras beans a lot and bought some for a gift for friends.
A very nice place to drink a quality coffee in the Old Center. The order came quickly and the staff is friendly, involved, giving us additional details about the coffee.

Coffee was great here, definitely our favourite during our visit to Bucharest. We went a few times. The staff were great too and super knowledgeable. Different types of coffee to try too. They offer milk alternatives as well which is great

Big quantity and quality of coffees.. the café was busy with customers all the time, the service was quick and nice.. important: we liked that they served free water (mineral natural ) , so rare in Bucharest ..

Located near the Old City Centre, [cafe] is a cozy cafe with good coffee and amazing people. The baristas are friendly and helpful, explaining the coffee origins, the best vegetable milk combination for that particular origin, and so on. You can either take a seat at the table or grab the coffee and take a walk to Cismigiu Gardens or Calea Victoriei and enjoy the day. They also serve cocktails starting at 5 PM. I do recommend it if you are in the area.
good and terrible coffee, if you ask for something else, speculate and burn yourself. for example soy milk €1 / a 1l can is €3
Maybe you could tell me the price of things BEFORE adding them to the cart? Unreasonable request, I know, but please, help a guy out!?
My app logged me out and I keep getting a message to check back later. I deleted the app and reinstalled it and cannot get in to my account. I am not going to [brand] until my app is fixed.

If I don’t have enough money on a gift card then I want to pay the remaining balance on my card. I don’t want to have to reload a minimum of $15 and not only is that the minimum, it automatically has it set for $25 unless you scroll. That seems like an sneaky, abusive practice.

Every time that I try to login into my [brand] app account it won’t let me login and I have been trying to do that for the past two weeks and it won’t let me access my gift card that is already loaded on there so when I order it will be ready to go and the customer service number for this issue did nothing to help me rectify this situation.
Their app is so easy to manage and is very convenient in tight situations.

If smoothly means I don’t have the right to see the price of what I’m paying for and not being able to use the gift card I refill to pay for my delivery order then you have a problem with the English language. You also got rid of the breakfast sandwiches what’s wrong with you people?!?
I loveee [brand] u can order on the app way faster

It’s hard to imagine a world before [brand] mobile order existed. As an airline pilot, it is very often the only thing that keeps me from being undercaffeinated on a 5AM flight. As far as I’m concerned, the only upside of the internet and technology in this century.

You need mobile thru line. Those without ap order at speaker and back up the line. Before covid you’d have them pull out and associate would deliver to car to move things along. No more. We with ap just wait wait wait. NOw mostly go elsewhere that has Mobil line. See my record. Used to order often. No more
I order my morning coffee thru the app, the staff knows me when I pick my coffee up at the drive up window. Thank you for your friendly attitude and great coffee!
So easy in a busy morning to get my hot perfect pumpkin spice latte. Makes my heart happy!

I use the app frequently to pick up my orders. The [brand] by my house is efficient, especially on busy mornings. I sometimes wish there was place to add feedback to a specific order. There has been times where my coffee isn’t filled remotely close to the size I order. However, most of the time it’s on point!

I work in the same town as my local [brand] just a two minute drive it makes coffee runs for my coworkers and I very easy when we can order on the app. Even brings me my coworkers closer together because we have our coffee time and we all get excited for the run.

No—you did the opposite with this update. The app was fine as it was, minus not showing prices before being added to cart, the new design hurts my eyes and you cannot scroll through different sections of the menu categories (i.e., cannot scroll through “Food”—only the individual sections within it). It logged me out when it first updated, and now keeps crashing. Tried ordering and keeps coming up with a message that says “something went wrong on our end” when I try to check out. I am trying to get food during my short break, I cannot try again later. Never had any such problems whatsoever before, please stop making pointless, erroneous updates. It’s not like this update gave us the ability to see the prices or made any other actual improvement.
turned up had to order online come on [brand] get your act together !!!
Order half way round [shop] ready for pick up at the end🙂
Easy to use. I like to order my coffees in advance and collect. So very convenient for me.
the rewards do NOT inspire me to go out to your store. why not do coffee and cake £3.99? it's a no brainer. as it stands - a coffee and cake £5.99? nah don't think so ...

What is the point of the app if you cannot trust which items are available? After i paid and went to the shop they said they’d stops my food to someone else but they couldn’t refund me and neither can the app so i have to waste time writing to customer services and hoping for an eventual refund!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Great app – would love a favourites / quick re-order feature I use the [brand] app regularly, mainly for drive-through orders on my commute, and overall it works really well. Mobile ordering is quick and convenient, and the recent orders feature is helpful. One improvement I’d love to see is the ability to save a drink as a favourite or have a one-tap quick re-order option, similar to what [brand] offers. It would make repeat ordering even faster, especially during busy mornings. Apart from that, great app and I’ll keep using it regularly.
Buy 10 to get a freebie no thanks wondered why I gave up with this app
Use the app to buy coffee when shopping and it ready by the time I’m finished just works great

I wanted to buy a cup of coffee this lovely Sunday morning, but I found out I was logged out. Tried to log on, but the app kept saying my credentials were incorrect. Tried to restore, but haven’t received an email. Tried several times, no results. Signed up again, and found out all beans were removed . I won’t use [brand] anymore, will buy [brand]
Normally I do the drive through but decided to sit in very quick ordering on the app
For whatever reason the app won’t let me register with my name. Great app besides.
